title: Sunday Sea Crumble
description: A delicious and easy-to-make seafood dish perfect for a lazy Sunday. This crumble topping adds a crunchy texture and a burst of flavor.

ingredients.name: Crumble Topping
ingredients.notes: made with salt and lazy love

instructions: 2. Season the fish fillets with sea salt and set aside.
3. In a separate pan, heat the bhuna sauce over medium heat.
4. Add the Sunday sauce mix to the bhuna sauce and stir well.
5. Place the fish fillets in a baking dish and spoon the sauce mixture over the top.
6. Sprinkle the crumble topping evenly over the sauce.
7. Bake in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
